t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The same gnome can give the higher 5x total, so try to spot the pattern. Similarly, the gnome giving 0 scores seems to be the same. However, the pattern can change!

vb_textbox.text: I found that the 5x total gnome would appear on one side only for a time (either left or right), so I would advise staying to the left or right.  For the 1x gnomes, it seemed to either be left or right giving the highest score for a time or alternating between left then right. Again, try to find the pattern and stay consistent!  Good luck.
